description: Defines an abstract Razor Page class for OrchardCore, providing methods and properties for shape rendering, layout management, localization, and page title handling within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: An abstract Razor Page class for OrchardCore, providing shape rendering, layout, localization, and title management functionalities.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Renders a shape or HTML content asynchronously.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method to render a shape asynchronously.

methods.name: RenderTitleSegments
methods.description: Adds a segment to the page title and generates the full title content.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Creates a TagBuilder for rendering a shape, with optional tag name.

methods.name: IsSectionDefined
methods.description: Checks if a layout zone is defined or has items.

methods.name: RenderSectionAsync
methods.description: Renders a specified layout zone asynchronously, with optional requirement enforcement.

methods.name: OrDefault
methods.description: Returns the first argument if not null or empty, otherwise returns the second.
